Наклон в пространстве (tilt-in-space) со: Tilt-in-space keeps the hip and knee angles the same, taking load off the pelvis and helping hold the head and trunk up. So that a manual wheelchair does not tip over, the seat shifts forward as it tilts, and anti-tippers are fitted at the back.
